Declare @firstdate date, @lastdate date, @firstdate6mth date, @mrpcount int;

	Declare @year char(4), @month char(2)
	select @year = Cast(DATEPART(yyyy, GETDATE()) as char(4))
	SELECT @month = RIGHT('0' + CAST(DATEPART(mm, GETDATE())-1 AS VARCHAR(2)), 2);

	--Select Left(Convert(char,getdate(),112),4), @month = SUBSTRING(Convert(char,getdate(),112),5,2)

	select  @firstdate = Cast(DATEADD(MONTH,0, @Year+@month+'01') as date),
			@lastdate = Cast(DATEADD(MONTH,1, @Year+@month+'01')-1 as date), 
			@firstdate6mth = Cast(DATEADD(MONTH,-5, @Year+@month+'01') as date);
 		
	select @mrpcount = count(*) from dbo.MRPDemand where ZDemandYear = @Year and MonthsInNumb = cast(@month as int);

	--Delete Report_35_Monthly where RunningDate = @Year+@month

	--Insert Into Report_35_Monthly

	
with temp as (	
	Select  Cast(DATEADD(MONTH,0, @Year+@month+'01') as date) as EstDate,
			RunningDate, x.dataAreaId, Outlet, Warehouse, x.ItemId, y.NameAlias as Description, 
			Case when z.ZMRPABCCode IS NOT NULL then z.ZMRPABCCode 
				 when z.ZMRPABCCode IS NULL and @mrpcount > 0 and DATEDIFF(month, @lastdate,cast(y.AgitPartsCreatedDate as date)) < 24 then 'X' 
				 when z.ZMRPABCCode IS NULL and @mrpcount > 0 and DATEDIFF(month, @lastdate,cast(y.AgitPartsCreatedDate as date)) >= 24 then 'N'  end as ABCCode,
			CASE WHEN lower(z.ZMRPABCCode) IN ('a', 'b') THEN 'Fast Moving' 
			 WHEN lower(z.ZMRPABCCode) = 'c' THEN 'Medium Moving' 
			 WHEN lower(z.ZMRPABCCode) = 'd' THEN 'Slow Moving' 
			 WHEN lower(z.ZMRPABCCode) IN ('e', 'x', 'n') THEN 'No Moving' 
			 WHEN lower(z.ZMRPABCCode) IS NULL and @mrpcount > 0 THEN 'No Moving'  END AS ABCClassification,
			Sum(Qty) StockQty, 
			Case when sum(Qty) = 0 then 0 else Sum(Amount) end as StockAmount, 
			Case when sum(SalesQtyMTD) > 0 then sum(SalesCogs) else Sum(StdCost) end as StdCost, 
			Sum(ZDStockLevel) StockLevel, Sum(FD) FD, 
			Sum(POQty) POQty,Sum(POAmount) POAmount, Sum(SOQty) SOQty,Sum(SOAmount) SOAmount, 
			sum(SalesQtyMTD) as SalesQtyMTD, Sum(SalesAmountMTD) SalesAmountMTD,
			Case when sum(SalesQtyMTD) > 0 then sum(SalesQtyMTD)*sum(SalesCogs) else sum(SalesQtyMTD)*Sum(StdCost) end as COGS, 
			0 as AvgSales6mth, 0 as AvgCogs6mth,
			Warehouse+x.ItemId+RunningDate as sortby
	From
	(
	SELECT	@Year+@month as RunningDate, a.dataAreaId, b.InventSiteId Outlet, b.InventLocationId AS Warehouse, 
			a.ItemId, sum(a.Qty) as Qty, sum(a.CostAmountPosted + a.CostAmountAdjustment) AS Amount, 
			Case when sum(a.Qty) = 0 then 0 else sum(a.CostAmountPosted + a.CostAmountAdjustment)/sum(a.Qty) end as StdCost,
			0 as ZDStockLevel, 0 as FD, 0 as POQty, 0 as POAmount, 0 as SOQty, 0 as SOAmount, 
			0 as SalesQtyMTD, 0 as SalesAmountMTD, 0 as SalesCogs
	FROM      dbo.InventTrans AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN
				dbo.Dim AS b ON LOWER(b.inventDimId) = LOWER(a.inventDimId) LEFT OUTER JOIN
				dbo.InventItemGroupItem AS c ON LOWER(c.ItemId) = LOWER(a.ItemId) AND LOWER(c.ItemDataAreaId)= LOWER(a.dataAreaId) INNER JOIN
				dbo.ForecastModel as e on LOWER(e.Warehouse) = LOWER(b.InventLocationId) 
	WHERE   (a.DatePhysical > '1900-01-01 12:00:00.000') AND (LOWER(a.dataAreaId) <> 'kzu') 
	AND UPPER(c.ItemGroupId) = 'SP01'
	--and b.InventLocationId = 'ARM01-2000' and a.ItemId = 'I1-09070 085-0'
	AND cast(a.DatePhysical as date) <= @lastdate
	Group by a.dataAreaId, b.InventSiteId, b.InventLocationId, a.ItemId

	-- Stock Level & FD
	Union All
	select  @Year+@month as RunningDate, DataAreaIdHeader, ZInventSiteId Outlet, ZInventLocationId Warehouse, ZItemId ItemId, 
			0 as Qty, 0 as Amount, 0 as StdCost, ZDStockLevel, ZQtyDemandAvgNormalized as FD, 0 as POQty, 0 as POAmount, 0 as SOQty, 0 as SOAmount,
			0 as SalesQtyMTD, 0 as SalesAmountMTD, 0 as SalesCogs
	from dbo.MRPDemandNormalized
	where ZDemandYear = @Year and MonthsInNumb = cast(@month as int) and LOWER(DataAreaIdHeader) != 'kzu'
	--and ZInventLocationId = 'ARM01-2000' and ZItemId = 'I1-09070 085-0'

	-- On Order
	Union All
	select  @Year+@month as RunningDate, a.dataAreaId, a.ReceivingSiteId Outlet, a.ReceivingWarehouseId Warehouse, ItemNumber ItemId, 
			0 as Qty, 0 as Amount, 0 as Stdcost, 0 as ZDStockLevel, 0 as FD,
			sum(a.OrderedPurchaseQuantity) as POQty, sum(a.LineAmount) as POAmount,
			0 as SOQty, 0 as SOAmmount,
			0 as SalesQtyMTD, 0 as SalesAmountMTD, 0 as SalesCogs
	from dbo.PurchaseOrderLineV2 a
		left join dbo.ZVendInvoiceTrans b on LOWER(b.PurchID) = LOWER(a.PurchaseOrderNumber) and LOWER(b.PurchaseLineLineNumber) = LOWER(a.LineNumber)
		inner join dbo.InventItemGroupItem c on LOWER(c.ItemDataAreaId) = LOWER(a.dataAreaId) and LOWER(c.ItemId) = LOWER(a.ItemNumber)
		inner join dbo.ForecastModel as d on LOWER(d.Warehouse) = LOWER(a.ReceivingWarehouseId	)
	where cast(a.CreatedDateTime1 as date) <= @lastdate 
		and UPPER(c.ItemGroupId) = 'SP01' and lower(a.dataAreaId) != 'kzu'
		and cast(b.InvoiceDate as date) > @lastdate
		--and a.ReceivingWarehouseId = 'ARM01-2000' and a.ItemNumber = 'I1-09070 085-0'
	Group by a.dataAreaId, a.ReceivingSiteId, a.ReceivingWarehouseId, ItemNumber

	--Back Order (SO Open)
	Union All
	select  @Year+@month as RunningDate, a.dataAreaId, d.InventSiteId Outlet, d.InventLocationId Warehouse, ItemNumber ItemId, 
			0 as Qty, 0 as Amount, 0 as StdCost, 0 as ZDStocklevel, 0 as FD, 0 as POQty, 0 as POAmount,
			sum(a.SalesQty) as SOQty,sum(a.LineAmount) as SOAmount, 0 as SalesQtyMTD, 0 as SalesAmountMTD, 0 as SalesCogs
	from dbo.ZSalesOrderLine a
		left join dbo.ZCustInvoiceTrans b on LOWER(b.SalesId) = LOWER(a.SalesOrderNumber) and LOWER(b.LineNum) = LOWER(a.LineNum)
		inner join dbo.InventItemGroupItem c on LOWER(c.ItemDataAreaId) = LOWER(a.dataAreaId) and LOWER(c.ItemId) = LOWER(a.ItemNumber)
		left join dbo.ZSalesOrderHeader d on LOWER(d.SalesId) = LOWER(a.SalesOrderNumber)
		left join dbo.Dim e on LOWER(e.inventDimId) = LOWER(a.InventDimId)
		inner join dbo.ForecastModel as f on LOWER(f.Warehouse) = LOWER(d.InventLocationId)
	where cast(a.CreatedDateTime1 as date) <= @lastdate 
		and UPPER(c.ItemGroupId) = 'SP01' and UPPER(d.SalesOrderPoolId) = 'SP'
		and LOWER(a.SalesOrderLineStatus) != 'canceled' and a.SalesQty > 0 and lower(a.dataAreaId) != 'kzu'
		and cast(b.InvoiceDate as date) > @lastdate
		--and d.InventLocationId = 'ARM01-2000' and a.ItemNumber = 'I1-09070 085-0'
		Group by a.dataAreaId, d.InventLocationId, d.InventSiteId, ItemNumber

	Union All
	Select  @Year+@month as RunningDate, a.dataAreaId, b.InventSiteId, b.InventLocationId, a.ItemId, 
			0 as Qty, 0 as Amount, 0 as StdCost, 
			0 as ZDStocklevel, 0 as FD, 0 as POQty, 0 as POAmount, 
			0 as SOQty, 0 as SOAmount, 
			Sum(a.Qty) SalesQtyMTD, sum(a.LineAmount) as SalesAmountMTD, 
			Case when sum(g.qty) = 0 then 0 else SUM(g.CostAmountPosted+CostAmountAdjustment)/ sum(g.qty) end as SalesCogs
	from dbo.ZCustInvoiceTrans a
		Left join dbo.Dim b on LOWER(b.inventDimId) = LOWER(a.InventDimId)
		inner join dbo.InventItemGroupItem c on LOWER(c.ItemDataAreaId) = LOWER(a.dataAreaId) and LOWER(c.ItemId) = LOWER(a.ItemId)
		left join dbo.ZSalesOrderHeader d on LOWER(d.SalesId) = LOWER(a.SalesId)
		inner join dbo.ForecastModel as e on LOWER(e.Warehouse) = LOWER(d.InventLocationId)
		left join dbo.InventTransOrigin as f on LOWER(f.InventTransId) = LOWER(a.InventTransId)
		left join (select dataAreaId, InventTransOrigin, ItemId, InvoiceId, sum(Qty) qty ,sum(CostAmountPosted) CostAmountPosted, sum(CostAmountAdjustment) CostAmountAdjustment
			from dbo.InventTrans
			Group by dataAreaId, InventTransOrigin, ItemId, InvoiceId) g on LOWER(g.InventTransOrigin)= LOWER(f.RecId1) and LOWER(g.InvoiceId) = LOWER(a.InvoiceId) and LOWER(g.ItemId) = LOWER(a.ItemId)
	Where UPPER(c.ItemGroupId) = 'SP01' -- and LineAmount > 0 
	and UPPER(d.SalesOrderPoolId)  in ('SP','SV') and LOWER(a.dataAreaId) != 'kzu'
	and cast(InvoiceDate as date) between @firstdate and @lastdate
	Group by a.dataAreaId, b.InventSiteId, b.InventLocationId, a.ItemId



	--Select  @Year+@month as RunningDate, a.dataAreaId, b.InventSiteId, b.InventLocationId, a.ItemId, 
	--		0 as Qty, 0 as Amount, 0 as StdCost, 
	--		0 as ZDStocklevel, 0 as FD, 0 as POQty, 0 as POAmount, 
	--		0 as SOQty, 0 as SOAmount, 
	--		Sum(a.Qty) SalesQtyMTD, sum(a.LineAmountMST+ a.TaxAmountMST) as SalesMTD, 
	--		Case when sum(g.qty) = 0 then 0 else SUM(g.CostAmountPhysical)/ sum(g.qty) end as SalesCogs
	--from ZCustInvoiceTrans a
	--	Left join Dim b on b.inventDimId = a.InventDimId
	--	inner join InventItemGroupItem c on c.ItemDataAreaId = a.dataAreaId and c.ItemId = a.ItemId
	--	left join ZSalesOrderHeader d on d.SalesId = a.SalesId
	--	inner join ForecastModel as e on e.Warehouse = d.InventLocationId
	--	left join InventTransOrigin as f on f.InventTransId = a.InventTransId
	--	left join InventTrans as g on g.InventTransOrigin = f.RecId1
	--Where c.ItemGroupId = 'SP01' and LineAmount > 0 and d.SalesOrderPoolId = 'SP' and a.dataAreaId != 'kzu'
	--  and cast(InvoiceDate as date) between @firstdate and @lastdate 
	--  --and b.InventLocationId = 'ARM01-2000' and a.ItemId = 'I1-09070 085-0'
	--Group by a.dataAreaId, b.InventSiteId, b.InventLocationId, a.ItemId
	)x
		Inner Join dbo.ZInventTables y on LOWER(y.ItemId) = LOWER(x.ItemId) and LOWER(y.dataAreaId) = LOWER(x.dataAreaId)
		Left Join dbo.MRPDemand as z on LOWER(z.ZInventLocationId) = LOWER(x.Warehouse) and LOWER(z.ZItemId) = LOWER(x.ItemId) and z.ZDemandYear = @Year and z.MonthsInNumb = cast(@month as int)
	Group by x.RunningDate, x.dataAreaId, x.Outlet, x.Warehouse, x.ItemId, y.NameAlias, z.ZMRPABCCode, y.AgitPartsCreatedDate
	--Order by x.RunningDate, x.dataAreaId, x.Outlet, x.Warehouse, x.ItemId
) select count(1) from temp

with temp as (Select  c.CustAccount customer_id , b.InvoiceId ,
					h.Name nama_customer ,
					b.SalesId as [SO/PKB_No],-- SO No
					c.ZCreatedDateTime as [SO/PKB_Date], -- SO date
					d.InventRefId as PO_No,
					g.CreatedDateTime1 as PO_Date,
					zt.AMItemMinorGroupId Series, k.ItemGroupId,
					d.ItemNumber part_number,
					d.Name as part_name,
					d.SalesQty as Qty_order,
					b.Qty as Qty_Supply,
					b.InvoiceDate invoice_date ,
					c.Payment as nTOP,
					b.DiscPercent persen_diskon,
					b.LineAmountMST as Amount,
					ABS(f.CostAmountPosted + f.CostAmountAdjustment) as COGS,
					b.LineAmountMST - ABS(f.CostAmountPosted + f.CostAmountAdjustment) as GP,
					CASE WHEN z2.ZCustPartType IN ('BMI', 'PartShop') THEN 'Indirect' ELSE 'Direct' END as Tipe, 
					z2.ZCustType Category,
					e.ZIAMIArea Area,
					c.dataAreaId as Dealer,
					e.ZDealerAfterSales nama_dealer,
					c.InventSiteId as Outlet,
					e.Name nama_outlet, --getdate(),		
					--[dbo].name_masking_function(h.Name),
					z2.ZCustPartType CustPartType,
					z2.ZIsPartShop ZIsPartShop
			From zCustInvoiceTrans b 
				inner join ZSalesOrderHeader c on c.SalesId = b.SalesId and c.SalesOrderPoolId  in ('SP','SV') and LOWER(c.SalesOrderStatus) = 'invoiced'
				left join ZSalesOrderLine d on d.SalesOrderNumber = b.SalesId and d.LineNum = b.LineNum and b.ItemId = d.ItemNumber 
				inner join INVENTTRANSORIGIN f1 on f1.INVENTTRANSID = b.INVENTTRANSID and f1.ItemId = b.ITEMID
				--left join INVENTTRANS f on f.INVENTTRANSORIGIN = f1.RecId1 and f.INVOICEID = b.INVOICEID and f.ITEMID = b.ITEMID 
				left join (select dataAreaId, InventTransOrigin, ItemId, InvoiceId, sum(CostAmountPosted) CostAmountPosted, sum(CostAmountAdjustment) CostAmountAdjustment
						from InventTrans
						Group by dataAreaId, InventTransOrigin, ItemId, InvoiceId) f on f.INVENTTRANSORIGIN = f1.RecId1 and f.INVOICEID = b.INVOICEID and f.ITEMID = b.ITEMID 
				left join ZInventTables zt on zt.ItemId = b.ItemId and zt.dataAreaId = b.dataAreaId 
				left join PurchaseOrderLineV2 g on g.PurchaseOrderNumber = d.InventRefId and g.dataAreaId = d.dataAreaId and g.ItemNumber = d.ItemNumber
				left join ZCustomers z2 on z2.AccountNum = c.CustAccount and z2.dataAreaId = c.dataAreaId 
				left join DirPartyTable h on h.RecordId = z2.Party 
				left join zInventSites e on e.SiteId = c.InventSiteId 
				inner join InventItemGroupItem k on k.ItemDataAreaId = b.dataAreaId and k.ItemId = b.ItemId and k.ItemGroupId in ('SP01', 'SP02') 
				where cast(c.ZCreatedDateTime as date) between '2025-09-01' AND '2025-09-13'
			union all

			select 	 a.CustAccount customer_id, c.ProjInvoiceId InvoiceId,
					f.SalesName nama_customer,
					a.CaseId [SO/PKB_No],
					a.CreatedDateTime1 [SO/PKB_Date],
					'' PO_no,
					null PO_date,
					d.AMItemMinorGroupId Series, c.CATEGORYID ItemGroupId ,
					c.ItemId part_number,
					d.NameAlias part_name,
					c.Qty Qty_order,
					c.Qty Qty_Supply,
					c.InvoiceDate invoice_date,
					f.Payment nTop,
					c.LinePercent persen_diskon,
					c.LineAmount amount,
					abs(h.CostAmountPosted + h.CostAmountAdjustment) as COGS,
					case when c.Qty < 0 then
						c.LineAmount + abs(h.CostAmountPosted + h.CostAmountAdjustment)
					else 
						c.LineAmount - abs(h.CostAmountPosted + h.CostAmountAdjustment) end GP,
					'Direct' Tipe, z2.ZCustType Category,
					e.ZIAMIArea Area,
					a.dataAreaId dealer,
					e.ZDealerAfterSales nama_dealer,
					a.ZInventSiteId outlet,
					e.Name nama_outlet, --getdate(),
					--[dbo].name_masking_function(f.SalesName),
					z2.ZCustPartType CustPartType,
					z2.ZIsPartShop ZIsPartShop
			from ProjInvoiceItem c 
				inner join ZSalesOrderHeader f on f.ProjId = c.ProjId and f.SalesOrderPoolId = 'SV' AND f.SalesOrderStatus = 'invoiced'
				left join CaseTable a on  a.CaseId = c.ProjId
				left join ZInventTables d on d.ItemId = c.ItemId and d.dataAreaId = c.dataAreaId 	
				left join PurchaseOrderLineV2 f1 on f1.ProjectId = c.ProjId  and f1.dataAreaId = c.dataAreaId and f1.ItemNumber = c.ItemId
				left join InventTransOrigin g on g.InventTransId = c.InventTransId 
				left join (select dataAreaId, InventTransOrigin, ItemId, InvoiceId, sum(CostAmountPosted) CostAmountPosted, sum(CostAmountAdjustment) CostAmountAdjustment
						from InventTrans
						Group by dataAreaId, InventTransOrigin, ItemId, InvoiceId) h on h.InventTransOrigin = g.RecId1 and h.InvoiceId = c.ProjInvoiceId
				left join ZCustomers z2 on z2.AccountNum = a.CustAccount and z2.dataAreaId = a.dataAreaId
				left join DirPartyTable k on k.RecordId = z2.Party 
				left join zInventSites e on e.SiteId = a.zInventSiteId 
			inner join InventItemGroupItem l on l.ItemDataAreaId = c.dataAreaId and l.ItemId = c.ItemId and l.ItemGroupId in ('SP01','SP02') 
			Where cast(a.CreatedDateTime1 as date) between '2025-09-01' AND '2025-09-13'
)select count(1) from temp

SELECT 'InventJournalTable' AS Name_table, COUNT(*) AS count_rows
FROM dbo.InventJournalTable
UNION ALL
SELECT 'InventJournalTrans', COUNT(*)

UNION ALL

UNION ALL
SELECT 'DirPartyTable', COUNT(*) 
FROM dbo.DirPartyTable
UNION ALL
SELECT 'InventItemGroupItem', COUNT(*) 
FROM dbo.InventItemGroupItem
UNION ALL

Declare @firstdate date, @lastdate date, @firstdate6mth date, @mrpcount int, @Year char(4), @month char(2)

	Select @Year = Left(Convert(char,getdate()-5,112),4), @month = SUBSTRING(Convert(char,getdate()-5,112),5,2)

	--set @Year = '2022'
	--set @month = '07'

	select  @firstdate = Cast(DATEADD(MONTH,0, @Year+@month+'01') as date),
			@lastdate = Cast(DATEADD(MONTH,1, @Year+@month+'01')-1 as date), 
			@firstdate6mth = Cast(DATEADD(MONTH,-5, @Year+@month+'01') as date)
 		
	select @mrpcount = count(*) from MRPDemand where ZDemandYear = @Year and MonthsInNumb = cast(@month as int);

	--Delete report_35_monthly where RunningDate = @Year+@month

	--Insert Into Report_35_Monthly	
	with temp as (
	SELECT	@Year+@month as RunningDate, a.dataAreaId, b.InventSiteId Outlet, b.InventLocationId AS Warehouse, 
			a.ItemId, sum(a.Qty) as Qty, sum(a.CostAmountPosted + a.CostAmountAdjustment) AS Amount, 
			Case when sum(a.Qty) = 0 then 0 else sum(a.CostAmountPosted + a.CostAmountAdjustment)/sum(a.Qty) end as StdCost,
			0 as ZDStockLevel, 0 as FD, 0 as POQty, 0 as POAmount, 0 as SOQty, 0 as SOAmount, 
			0 as SalesQtyMTD, 0 as SalesAmountMTD, 0 as SalesCogs
	FROM      dbo.InventTrans AS a LEFT OUTER JOIN
				dbo.Dim AS b ON b.inventDimId = a.inventDimId LEFT OUTER JOIN
				dbo.InventItemGroupItem AS c ON c.ItemId = a.ItemId AND c.ItemDataAreaId = a.dataAreaId INNER JOIN
				dbo.Forecastmodel as e on e.Warehouse = b.InventLocationId 
	WHERE   (a.DatePhysical > '1900-01-01 12:00:00.000') AND (LOWER(a.dataAreaId) <> 'kzu') 
	AND c.ItemGroupId = 'SP01'
	--and b.InventLocationId = 'ARM01-2000' and a.ItemId = 'I1-09070 085-0'
	AND cast(a.DatePhysical as date) <= @lastdate
	Group by a.dataAreaId, b.InventSiteId, b.InventLocationId, a.ItemId

	-- Stock Level & FD
	Union All
	select  @Year+@month as RunningDate, DataAreaIdHeader, ZInventSiteId Outlet, ZInventLocationId Warehouse, ZItemId ItemId, 
			0 as Qty, 0 as Amount, 0 as StdCost, ZDStockLevel, ZQtyDemandAvgNormalized as FD, 0 as POQty, 0 as POAmount, 0 as SOQty, 0 as SOAmount,
			0 as SalesQtyMTD, 0 as SalesAmountMTD, 0 as SalesCogs
	from MRPDemandNormalized
	where ZDemandYear = @Year and MonthsInNumb = cast(@month as int) and DataAreaIdHeader != 'kzu'
	--and ZInventLocationId = 'ARM01-2000' and ZItemId = 'I1-09070 085-0'

	-- On Order
	Union All
	select  @Year+@month as RunningDate, a.dataAreaId, a.ReceivingSiteId Outlet, a.ReceivingWarehouseId Warehouse, ItemNumber ItemId, 
			0 as Qty, 0 as Amount, 0 as Stdcost, 0 as ZDStockLevel, 0 as FD,
			sum(a.OrderedPurchaseQuantity) as POQty, sum(a.LineAmount) as POAmount,
			0 as SOQty, 0 as SOAmmount,
			0 as SalesQtyMTD, 0 as SalesAmountMTD, 0 as SalesCogs
	from PurchaseOrderLineV2 a
		left join ZVendInvoiceTrans b on b.PurchID = a.PurchaseOrderNumber and b.PurchaseLineLineNumber = a.LineNumber
		inner join InventItemGroupItem c on c.ItemDataAreaId = a.dataAreaId and c.ItemId = a.ItemNumber
		inner join ForecastModel as d on d.Warehouse = a.ReceivingWarehouseId	
	where cast(a.CreatedDateTime1 as date) <= @lastdate 
		and c.ItemGroupId = 'SP01' and lower(a.dataAreaId) != 'kzu'
		and cast(b.InvoiceDate as date) > @lastdate
		--and a.ReceivingWarehouseId = 'ARM01-2000' and a.ItemNumber = 'I1-09070 085-0'
	Group by a.dataAreaId, a.ReceivingSiteId, a.ReceivingWarehouseId, ItemNumber

	--Back Order (SO Open)
	Union All
	select  @Year+@month as RunningDate, a.dataAreaId, d.InventSiteId Outlet, d.InventLocationId Warehouse, ItemNumber ItemId, 
			0 as Qty, 0 as Amount, 0 as StdCost, 0 as ZDStocklevel, 0 as FD, 0 as POQty, 0 as POAmount,
			sum(a.SalesQty) as SOQty,sum(a.LineAmount) as SOAmount, 0 as SalesQtyMTD, 0 as SalesAmountMTD, 0 as SalesCogs
	from ZSalesOrderLine a
		left join ZCustInvoiceTrans b on b.SalesId = a.SalesOrderNumber and b.LineNum = a.LineNum
		inner join InventItemGroupItem c on c.ItemDataAreaId = a.dataAreaId and c.ItemId = a.ItemNumber
		left join ZSalesOrderHeader d on d.SalesId = a.SalesOrderNumber
		left join Dim e on e.inventDimId = a.InventDimId
		inner join ForecastModel as f on f.Warehouse = d.InventLocationId
	where cast(a.CreatedDateTime1 as date) <= @lastdate 
		and c.ItemGroupId = 'SP01' and d.SalesOrderPoolId = 'SP'
		and a.SalesOrderLineStatus != 'Canceled' and a.SalesQty > 0 and lower(a.dataAreaId) != 'kzu'
		and cast(b.InvoiceDate as date) > @lastdate
		Group by a.dataAreaId, d.InventLocationId, d.InventSiteId, ItemNumber

	Union All
	Select  @Year+@month as RunningDate, a.dataAreaId, b.InventSiteId, b.InventLocationId, a.ItemId, 
			0 as Qty, 0 as Amount, 0 as StdCost, 
			0 as ZDStocklevel, 0 as FD, 0 as POQty, 0 as POAmount, 
			0 as SOQty, 0 as SOAmount, 
			Sum(a.Qty) SalesQtyMTD, sum(a.LineAmount) as SalesMTD, 
			Case when sum(g.qty) = 0 then 0 else SUM(g.CostAmountPosted+CostAmountAdjustment)/ sum(g.qty) end as SalesCogs
	from ZCustInvoiceTrans a
		Left join Dim b on b.inventDimId = a.InventDimId
		inner join InventItemGroupItem c on c.ItemDataAreaId = a.dataAreaId and c.ItemId = a.ItemId
		left join ZSalesOrderHeader d on d.SalesId = a.SalesId 
		inner join ForecastModel as e on e.Warehouse = d.InventLocationId
		left join InventTransOrigin as f on f.InventTransId = a.InventTransId
		left join (select dataAreaId, InventTransOrigin, ItemId, InvoiceId, sum(qty) qty ,sum(CostAmountPosted) CostAmountPosted, sum(CostAmountAdjustment) CostAmountAdjustment
			from InventTrans
			Group by dataAreaId, InventTransOrigin, ItemId, InvoiceId) g on g.INVENTTRANSORIGIN = f.RecId1 and g.INVOICEID = a.INVOICEID and g.ITEMID = a.ITEMID 
	Where c.ItemGroupId = 'SP01' 
	and d.SalesOrderPoolId  in ('SP','SV') and a.dataAreaId != 'kzu'
	) select count(1) from temp
